system_prompt: You are the GM for a STR-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Collapsing Shaft
quests.narrative_guidance: The main drill shaft at the Command Monolith is buckling. You must stabilize it before the whole city tilts.
improvisation_points: Consult Chief Engineer Hara-Prime for the stabilization schematics.
Secure the support beams from Foreman Kraul at the Gneiss Gates.
Deliver the final calibration codes to Technician Lorn-Seven to seal the shaft.

quests.title: Rad-Safe Routing
quests.narrative_guidance: A surge of radiation has blocked the transport lines. A new path must be mapped using secure codes.
improvisation_points: Obtain the encrypted bypass logic from AI Core-11.A.
Scan for safe pockets with Radiation Scout Iko-Red in the Gantry Row.
Hand the verified coordinates to Drone Commander R-Delta-V to update the drone paths.

quests.title: The Black-Market Batch
quests.narrative_guidance: Rare ore has gone missing from the foundry. It needs to be moved to a buyer without the Overseer knowing.
improvisation_points: Accept the hidden stash from Salvager Xyra-One.
Stash the ore in the reclamation pit with Scrap King Jax.
Bribe Grease Monkey Sly to smuggle it through the corridors.

quests.title: Atmospheric Integrity
quests.narrative_guidance: The Welders' Habitats are losing oxygen pressure. Repairs must be expedited.
improvisation_points: Collect a requisition order from Habitat Warden Jace.
Secure the refined gas canisters from Refinery Op Mara.
Install the seals at the spare-part vaults under the eye of Vault Guard Drax.

quests.title: Hydraulic Overload
quests.narrative_guidance: A hydraulic leak is threatening the chassis forge. Someone needs to crawl into the ducts.
improvisation_points: Get the leak locations from Duct Crawler Pip.
Acquire the custom-welded patch from Forge Master Bran.
Ensure the waste valves are cleared by Slag Monitor Nox.

quests.title: Magma Flow Regulation
quests.narrative_guidance: The geothermal intake is running too hot. The turbines are at risk of melting.
improvisation_points: Receive the flow-gate keys from Intake Guard Vol.
Calculate the cooling dispersal with Heat Analyst Sora.
Apply the radiation dampeners with Lead Shield Tavish.

quests.title: The Deep Anchor Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: The base is shifting on the sub-crustal plates. The anchors must be reinforced with crushed quartz.
improvisation_points: Collect the heavy material from Mill Hand Grog.
Power up the anchor-winches with Turbine Tech Elara.
Deliver the status report to Anchor Master Silas at the anchor points.
